departments.name: Computer Science & Engineering
departments.about: The Department of Computer Science & Engineering at North South University is the country's first private-university CSE programme, accredited by IEB and BAETE. We run 14 research labs across AI, HCI, networks and systems, and place over 400 graduates into industry every year. This hub is the department's official channel for notices, office hours, opportunities and student support.

departments.name: Electrical & Computer Engineering
departments.about: The Department of Electrical & Computer Engineering combines power, electronics, embedded systems and communication engineering under one roof. Our VLSI and IoT labs support both undergraduate capstone projects and funded research collaborations with industry partners across Bangladesh.

departments.name: Department of Accounting & Finance
departments.about: The School of Business & Economics runs the largest undergraduate programme at NSU. The department maintains an active corporate advisory board, a CFA-aligned finance track and a placement pipeline into every major bank and MNC operating in Bangladesh.

departments.name: Department of Architecture
departments.about: The Department of Architecture trains designers who build for a delta. Studio work runs from climate-responsive housing to heritage conservation, supported by a fabrication workshop and an annual thesis exhibition open to the whole campus.

seeking.headline: Seeking Marketing Internship
seeking.bioPreview: Digital marketing student experienced in campaign planning, social media and public speaking.
seeking.fullBio: Third-year BBA student majoring in Marketing. I have run social media for two campus clubs, planned a 3-week awareness campaign that reached 40k accounts organically, and completed a summer internship at Unilever Bangladesh. I am comfortable with Canva, Meta Business Suite and basic analytics reporting, and I am looking for a structured marketing internship where I can own a channel end to end.

seeking.headline: Available for 3D Visualisation & Rendering Projects
seeking.bioPreview: Architecture student offering photorealistic 3D renders, walkthroughs and presentation boards.
seeking.fullBio: Final-year Architecture student currently working on a thesis about sustainable low-cost housing. I take on freelance visualisation work for small studios and independent clients: exterior and interior renders, animated walkthroughs and competition boards. I work in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Lumion and Photoshop and I always deliver a revision round within the quoted timeline.

seeking.headline: Looking for Part-Time Frontend Developer Role
seeking.bioPreview: Sophomore CSE student building React interfaces and contributing to open source in my spare time.
seeking.fullBio: Second-year CSE student and active competitive programmer. I have shipped three React projects, two of them with real users from campus clubs, and I contribute small fixes to open source component libraries. I am looking for a part-time frontend role of around 20 hours a week that fits around my class schedule. I have no formal industry experience yet, so mentorship matters more to me than pay.

seeking.headline: Seeking Research Assistant Role in IoT / Embedded Systems
seeking.bioPreview: Final-year ECE student with hands-on experience in sensor networks and embedded firmware.
seeking.fullBio: Final-year ECE student working on a smart home energy monitoring system as my capstone project. I have built and deployed sensor networks using ESP32 and Arduino, written firmware in C, and handled data logging pipelines to Firebase. I would like to assist a faculty member on an ongoing IoT or embedded systems research project and eventually co-author a conference paper.

seeking.headline: Open to Campus Ambassador Opportunities
seeking.bioPreview: First-year BBA student, active club volunteer and comfortable speaking in front of large groups.
seeking.fullBio: Freshman BBA student and volunteer with NSU YES. I helped coordinate registration for a 600-person career session last semester and regularly host club orientation sessions. I know the campus community well and I am looking for a campus ambassador role with a brand that actually wants on-ground activity, not just social posts.

seeking.headline: Graduating CSE Student Seeking Backend Engineer Role
seeking.bioPreview: Graduating in December with two backend internships and production experience in Node.js and Go.
seeking.fullBio: I graduate in December 2026 and I am looking for a full-time backend engineering role starting January. I interned at Brain Station 23 and then at a fintech startup where I owned a payment reconciliation service handling around 20k transactions a day. I work mainly in Node.js and Go, with PostgreSQL and Redis, and I am comfortable owning deployments on AWS.

seeking.headline: Available for HSC Physics & Higher Math Tuition
seeking.bioPreview: Three years of tuition experience with HSC students, currently teaching two batches in Bashundhara.
seeking.fullBio: CSE student who has been teaching HSC Physics and Higher Mathematics since my first year. I currently run two small batches in Bashundhara R/A and prefer teaching in person so I can work through problems on paper. I follow the board syllabus closely, set weekly practice tests, and share written solutions after every session. Happy to take one or two more students.

seeking.headline: Seeking Data Analyst Internship
seeking.bioPreview: Economics student comfortable with SQL, Python and building dashboards from messy survey data.
seeking.fullBio: Third-year Economics student with a strong quantitative focus. I cleaned and analysed a 12,000-response household survey for a faculty research project and built the dashboard the team still uses. Comfortable with SQL, pandas, and Power BI. I am looking for a data analyst internship where I can work with real business data rather than tutorial datasets.

seeking.headline: Applying for Teaching Assistant — Programming Language I
seeking.bioPreview: CGPA 3.89 in CSE, previously assisted two lab sections and ran weekly doubt-solving hours.
seeking.fullBio: Senior CSE student with a 3.89 CGPA. I have informally assisted two CSE 115 lab sections, prepared practice problem sets, and run weekly doubt-solving sessions that regularly draw 30+ juniors. I am applying to be a formal teaching assistant for Programming Language I or Data Structures for the upcoming semester.

seeking.headline: Seeking Part-Time Role in Pharmaceutical QA
seeking.bioPreview: Pharmacy student with laboratory experience in quality control testing and documentation.
seeking.fullBio: Fourth-year Pharmacy student. I completed a supervised placement in a quality control laboratory where I handled dissolution and assay testing and maintained batch documentation to GMP standards. I am looking for a part-time or weekend role with a pharmaceutical or diagnostics company while I finish my final year.

seeking.headline: Taking Flutter App Development Projects
seeking.bioPreview: Built and published four Flutter apps, two of them for local businesses with live users.
seeking.fullBio: CSE student and mobile developer. I have published four Flutter applications, including a delivery tracking app for a local grocery chain that is still in production. I handle the full cycle: UI build, Firebase integration, Play Store release and a month of post-launch fixes. Currently paused while I finish my summer semester finals.

seeking.headline: English & IELTS Speaking Tuition Available
seeking.bioPreview: English major with an 8.0 IELTS band, previously coached six students through their speaking module.
seeking.fullBio: English literature student with an overall IELTS band of 8.0 and 8.5 in speaking. I have coached six students through the speaking and writing modules, with a focus on fluency drills and structured answer frameworks rather than memorised templates. This post has expired while I focus on my final semester.

seeking.headline: Seeking Full-Time Hardware Design Engineer Role
seeking.bioPreview: Recent ECE graduate with PCB design experience and two completed industrial automation projects.
seeking.fullBio: I completed my ECE degree this summer. My final year project was a modular motor controller board that is now used in a small production line in Tongi. I design in Altium, handle component sourcing, and I am comfortable debugging with an oscilloscope and logic analyser. Looking for a full-time hardware or embedded design role in Dhaka.

seeking.headline: Seeking Product Design Internship
seeking.bioPreview: Interface designer with a case-study portfolio covering research, wireframes and shipped screens.
seeking.fullBio: CSE student who moved into product design after two hackathons. My portfolio has three full case studies, each covering user interviews, wireframes, a design system and the final shipped screens. I run usability sessions with real students rather than guessing, and I can hand off cleanly to developers because I still write frontend code.

events.title: NSU Career Fair Summer 2026
events.shortDescription: Meet leading employers and explore graduate opportunities directly on campus.
events.description: The official NSU Career Fair connects students with over 50 top national and multinational companies. Bring your resumes, participate in on-the-spot interviews, and discover your next internship or full-time role. Registration is mandatory for entry.

organizer.name: Career and Placement Center (CPC)
organizer.description: Official career support office of North South University.

events.venueDetails: Level 1 and Level 2, North South University campus.
events.registrationInfo: Registration is free for verified NSU students. Alumni must show verified ID.

events.title: Responsible AI Research Talk
events.shortDescription: Exploring ethical considerations in deploying LLMs in healthcare.
events.description: Join Dr. Aminul Islam as he discusses the ethical deployment of large language models in healthcare settings, addressing bias, privacy, and regulatory compliance.
events.registrationInfo: Seats are strictly limited to 150 due to venue capacity.

events.title: UI/UX Design Bootcamp
events.shortDescription: A 2-day intensive bootcamp on Figma, prototyping, and user research.
events.description: Kickstart your journey in product design. Learn wireframing, high-fidelity prototyping, and foundational user research principles from industry experts.

organizer.name: NSU ACM Student Chapter
organizer.description: The premier computer science student community at NSU.

events.registrationInfo: Workshop fee: 500 BDT. Includes lunch and digital certificate.

events.title: Freshers’ Orientation Summer 2026
events.shortDescription: Welcome to North South University! Mandatory for all incoming students.
events.description: The official orientation program for the Summer 2026 incoming batch. Get to know campus facilities, academic rules, clubs, and meet your faculty members.
events.registrationInfo: No prior registration required. Bring your provisional ID slip.

events.title: Campus Ambassador Hiring Session
events.shortDescription: Become the face of Grameenphone on campus.
events.description: Grameenphone is looking for energetic students to join their campus ambassador program. Discover the perks and apply on-site.
events.registrationInfo: Event cancelled due to unavoidable circumstances.
events.notificationMessage: Event has been cancelled by the organizer.

events.title: CSE Project Showcase & Hackathon
events.shortDescription: Thirty-six hours, 60 teams, and the best capstone projects of the semester on show.
events.description: The CSE Department’s flagship end-of-semester event. Capstone teams demo their projects to faculty and industry judges on day one; day two is an open hackathon on the theme “Tech for Bangladesh”. Prizes for the top three teams and internship interviews with partner companies.
events.registrationInfo: Teams of 2–4. At least one member must be a current CSE student.

events.title: Alumni Tech Talk: Careers in Cloud
events.shortDescription: Tanvir Hasan (AWS, Batch 15) on building a cloud career from Dhaka.
events.description: CSE alumnus Tanvir Hasan, Cloud Solutions Architect at AWS Singapore, talks about certifications, remote roles and what hiring managers look for. Followed by an open Q&A and CV clinic with the CSE industry internship coordinator.
events.registrationInfo: Free for NSU students and alumni. Seats are first come, first served.

events.title: ECE IoT & Robotics Expo
events.shortDescription: Live demos from the VLSI, IoT and robotics labs — open to the whole campus.
events.description: The ECE Department opens its labs for a day of live demos: smart-farming sensors, line-following robots, a RISC-V core on FPGA and more. Industry partners from Samsung R&D and Robi Axiata judge the student project track.
events.registrationInfo: No registration needed. Bring your NSU ID.

events.title: SBE Case Competition 2026
events.shortDescription: Crack a live business case from a partner bank in 48 hours.
events.description: Teams of four receive a live case from a partner bank and present their recommendation to a panel of senior bankers and faculty. Winners receive a cash prize and fast-track interviews for the partner’s management-trainee programme.

organizer.name: Accounting & Finance Department
organizer.description: Department of Accounting & Finance, School of Business & Economics.

events.registrationInfo: Teams of four. Open to all SBE students.

events.title: Architecture Thesis Exhibition 2026
events.shortDescription: Final-year thesis projects on building for a delta — models, drawings and juries.
events.description: The annual thesis exhibition of the Department of Architecture. Twenty-four final-year projects on climate-responsive housing, heritage and waterfront design, with public juries every afternoon. Open to the whole campus.
events.registrationInfo: Free entry for everyone with a campus ID.
